preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100000.
For each test case, the length of the sequence N must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= i for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element B[i] in the sequence must be between 1 and i.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if all(B[i] == i for i in range(N)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if all elements in B are equal to their indices, otherwise output 'NO'.
